📖 LEARNED: Tracking People (Level 1). People leave sign: broken twigs, footprints, disturbed earth. You can follow.

📖 LEARNED: Hogtie (Level 1). Rope, a dazed monster, and thirty seconds of not being eaten. Hogtie a controlled monster: rooted 3 rounds (diminishing), and it can't wind up telegraphs. It can still lash out — the rope holds position, not malice.

◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
The village's quarrel was with Nathan — and Nathan is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
You knew Nathan — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting them, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
At the grave, Henry, Ruth, Fatima speak for Lucas — "Nathan trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Lucas before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.

transcript.line: You catch fragments by the fire — Henry telling Ruth about you. The retelling is already better than the event.
📯 ALL CLEAR — the treeline is quiet. The hall door unbars; the village breathes out and goes back to work.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Loud Beast gorges at the treeline — 1,376 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Terms of Service gorges at the treeline — 1,250 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Ugly Thing gorges at the treeline — 550 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
A lean scout waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.
Village meal: +2200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
Desmond came back with 715 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 358 kcal in, 357 kcal eaten at the fire.
Ruth and Henry lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Chantal takes one look at the full shelves and unshoulders the pack. "Leave the wild standing. Hauling water for the cistern."
🍽️ Ruth carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."
💧 The cistern's recovered — full cups again, and nobody's guarding the dipper.

🌙 Raid — Thornfield came in the night from the southeast. They trampled 2 garden plots into mud. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
— DAY 97 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
👀 "ER nurse, huh?" Desmond nods — then, an hour later, drops a shop-talk detail no ER nurse would ever get right. They catch themselves. Too late.
"The audience is watching. The gamblers are watching. Everyone's watching. No pressure."
📦 A care package drops from the sky with a little parachute. There's a note: "WE LOVE YOU!"
Inside: Hardlight knife
Plus 33 kcal of fan-approved snacks.

"You don't chase anymore. You ARRIVE. The gamblers have noticed — your fights start before the monster knows it's in one. One more step, little hunter." The shape is clear now: Bring down stronger, unwounded prey: alone, or with Pack Hunt actually called on it and every ally alive and still with you. Its opening health must exceed your whole health bar..
